# DiffBind consensus peakset + paired differential accessibility
# Normal (N) vs tumor-associated (Met) mouse vessel ATAC-seq, paired by patient

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DiffBind))

samples <- data.frame(
  SampleID   = c("N1","N3","N4","N6","Met1","Met3","Met4","Met6"),
  Condition  = c("Normal","Normal","Normal","Normal","Met","Met","Met","Met"),
  patient    = c("P1","P3","P4","P6","P1","P3","P4","P6"),
  bamReads   = file.path("/mnt/user-uploads/ATAC",
                         paste0("ATAC_", c("N1","N3","N4","N6","Met1","Met3","Met4","Met6"), "_clean.bam")),
  Peaks      = file.path("/workspace/atac/peaks",
                         paste0(c("N1","N3","N4","N6","Met1","Met3","Met4","Met6"), "_peaks.narrowPeak")),
  peakCaller = "narrow",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

dba <- dba(sampleSheet = samples, scoreCol = 5)
dba$config$RunParallel <- FALSE
dba <- dba.count(dba, bParallel = FALSE)
```

# Count reads in consensus peaks with DiffBind, then DESeq2 directly
# (DiffBind 3.16 design formulas only accept standard columns, so the
#  paired design ~ patient + condition is run in DESeq2 itself)

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))

# Consensus peak coordinates + raw counts
cnt <- dba.peakset(dba, bRetrieve = TRUE, DataType = DBA_DATA_FRAME)
count_cols <- grep("^N[0-9]$|^Met[0-9]$", colnames(cnt), value = TRUE)
counts <- as.matrix(cnt[, count_cols])
cat("count matrix class:", class(counts[1,1]), " head:\n")
print(head(counts[, 1:4]))
counts <- round(counts)  # ensure integer mode for DESeq2
storage.mode(counts) <- "integer"
colnames(counts) <- count_cols
rownames(counts) <- paste0("peak_", seq_len(nrow(counts)))
cat("Consensus peaks:", nrow(counts), "\n")

coldata <- data.frame(
  condition = factor(c("Normal","Normal","Normal","Normal","Met","Met","Met","Met"), levels = c("Normal","Met")),
  patient   = factor(c("P1","P3","P4","P6","P1","P3","P4","P6")),
  row.names = count_cols)
stopifnot(all(colnames(counts) == rownames(coldata)))

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = coldata,
                              design = ~ patient + condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "Met", "Normal"), alpha = 0.05)
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$chr <- as.character(cnt$CHR); res_df$start <- cnt$START; res_df$end <- cnt$END
res_df$width <- res_df$end - res_df$start
res_df <- res_df[, c("chr","start","end","width","baseMean","log2FoldChange","lfcSE","stat","pvalue","padj")]
saveRDS(list(dds = dds, counts = counts, peaks = cnt, res = res_df),
        "/workspace/atac/counts/dds_obj.rds")
write.csv(res_df, "/workspace/atac/counts/DA_peaks_all.csv", row.names = FALSE)

sig <- res_df[which(res_df$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) > 1 & !is.na(res_df$padj)), ]
gained <- sig[sig$log2FoldChange > 0, ]
lost   <- sig[sig$log2FoldChange < 0, ]
cat("DA peaks (FDR<0.05, |FC|>2):", nrow(sig),
    " gained:", nrow(gained), " lost:", nrow(lost), "\n")
write.csv(sig,    "/workspace/atac/counts/DA_peaks_sig.csv",    row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(gained, "/workspace/atac/counts/DA_peaks_gained.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(lost,   "/workspace/atac/counts/DA_peaks_lost.csv",   row.names = FALSE)
```

## PCA

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ComplexHeatmap))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(circlize))

obj <- readRDS("/workspace/atac/counts/dds_obj.rds")
res <- obj$res
dds <- obj$dds
counts <- obj$counts

pal <- c("Normal" = "#0279EE", "Tumor-associated" = "#FF9400")
res$direction <- ifelse(is.na(res$padj) | res$padj >= 0.05 | abs(res$log2FoldChange) <= 1, "NS",
                        ifelse(res$log2FoldChange > 0, "Gained in Met", "Lost in Met"))
res$direction <- factor(res$direction, levels = c("Gained in Met", "Lost in Met", "NS"))

# Volcano
res$lab <- -log10(pmax(res$padj, 1e-300))
p <- ggplot(res, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = lab, color = direction)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Gained in Met" = "#FF9400", "Lost in Met" = "#0279EE", "NS" = "grey75"),
                     name = NULL) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  labs(x = "log2 fold change (Met / Normal)", y = "-log10 FDR",
       title = "Differential accessibility: tumor-associated vs normal vessel") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Liberation Sans") + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave("/mnt/results/atac_vessel_analysis/DA_peaks/volcano_DA_peaks.svg", p, width = 6, height = 5)
ggsave("/workspace/atac/volcano.png", p, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 150)

# MA
p <- ggplot(res, aes(x = log2(baseMean + 1), y = log2FoldChange, color = direction)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Gained in Met" = "#FF9400", "Lost in Met" = "#0279EE", "NS" = "grey75"), name = NULL) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey30") +
  labs(x = "log2 mean accessibility", y = "log2 fold change (Met / Normal)") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Liberation Sans") + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave("/mnt/results/atac_vessel_analysis/DA_peaks/MA_DA_peaks.svg", p, width = 6, height = 5)

# PCA on VST-transformed counts (all peaks)
vsd <- vst(dds)
pca <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = c("condition", "patient"), returnData = TRUE)
pv <- round(100 * attr(pca, "percentVar"))
pd <- data.frame(pca[, c("PC1","PC2")], group = ifelse(grepl("^Met", rownames(pca)), "Tumor-associated", "Normal"))
p <- ggplot(pd, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = group, label = rownames(pd))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) + geom_text(vjust = -0.8, size = 3, family = "Liberation Sans", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", pv[1], "%)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", pv[2], "%)")) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Liberation Sans") + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave("/mnt/results/atac_vessel_analysis/QC_report/PCA_samples.svg", p, width = 5.5, height = 5)
ggsave("/workspace/atac/PCA.png", p, width = 5.5, height = 5, dpi = 150)

```
